coverage: Executed coverage is Bash availability/help metadata only; no operational behavior is counted as a pass.
Bash builtin discoverability and documented synopsis/description metadata
exclusions: No netstat operation was invoked; the backend reads live sock_diag and /proc socket state, forbidden by the task's execution limits.
No real or fixture-created network sockets, syscall shims, or proc overlays were executed; deterministic operation coverage requires a future disposable VM/mock run.
No matching GNU netstat parity case is claimed.
